statement: The function returns a result r. Define R_i = max_{0 <= j < n} grid[i][j] for 0 <= i < n and C_j = max_{0 <= i < n} grid[i][j] for 0 <= j < n. Then r = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} sum_{j=0}^{n-1} (min(R_i, C_j) - grid[i][j]).
